QUESTIONS RETAIL BUSINESSES ASK

What retail businesses ask before they switch.

Is Jwero built for small retailers or large chains?

Both, on the same system. A single-store business gets the whole operating system from day one; a chain gets the same one, with governance and branch structure that scale.

Does it matter if I sell mostly gold, mostly diamond, or a mix?

No, the catalogue, pricing engine and CRM handle purity, certification and material-specific fields for all of them.
